title: Tidy a messy folder
setup:
printf 'one
' > a.txt; printf 'two
' > b.txt; printf 'three
' > c.txt
printf '# Report\n' > report.md; printf 'x' > old.tmp; printf 'y' > cache.tmp; printf 'PNG' > photo.png
printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\necho ok\n' > run.sh; chmod 644 run.sh

checks.name: the three .txt files are in text/
no .txt files are left outside text/
backup/photo.png is a copy, and photo.png is still there

hints: A wildcard moves many files at once: mv *.txt text/ (the folder must exist first).
mv renames, cp copies, rm deletes, chmod +x makes a file runnable.
